purpose: Close AG-05 without rewriting P8/P9/P10: exercise the production postprocessor itself, reject affine scale or offset masking, bind output range and values, compare all five derived saliency features, and require exact peak positions.

historical_reference_contract.role: Immutable P10 source for the five fixture identities, frozen legacy arrays, checkpoint identity, and historical correlation evidence. Its previous verdict is not promoted to P2 acceptance.

threshold_authority.endpoint_self_abs_max: Exact identity is required because predict_saliency and the gate recomputation invoke the same pinned production postprocessor on the same captured raw array.
threshold_authority.e2e_abs_max: Prospective P2 absolute output-value threshold frozen before the first real-weight P2 execution. It prevents correlation-only or affine-normalized evidence from passing a materially different production map.
threshold_authority.feature_abs_max: Reused unchanged from historical_reused_authority.frozen_thresholds.feature_abs_max in the immutable P8 contract.
threshold_authority.peak_count_exact: Reused unchanged from historical_reused_authority.frozen_thresholds.peak_count_exact in the immutable P8 contract.
threshold_authority.peak_positions_exact: Prospective P2 strengthening required by the cross-audit acceptance objective; frozen before the first real-weight P2 execution.

comparison_policy.production_e2e: The actual captured predict_saliency return value is checked directly and MUST NOT be normalized, rescaled, clipped, or offset by the gate.
comparison_policy.production_self_check: Apply pinned saliency.postprocessing.postprocess_saliency to the captured production raw output and require exact equality with the captured production E2E output.
comparison_policy.legacy_reference: Apply the same pinned production postprocessor once to the frozen legacy raw saliency array at the fixture's original dimensions.
comparison_policy.output_contract: Production E2E must be float32, finite, correctly shaped, and either span exactly [0,1] or be the defined constant all-zero map.
comparison_policy.feature_check: Run the pinned production extract_saliency_features on the untouched production E2E map and on the one-time postprocessed legacy reference; every named feature must deviate by no more than feature_abs_max.
comparison_policy.peak_check: Use the exact peak mask shared with production peak counting and require both exact peak count and exact peak-mask positions.

required_mutation_evidence.scaled_map: Must fail even when Pearson correlation is 1.
required_mutation_evidence.positive_offset_map: Must fail even when Pearson correlation is 1.

out_of_scope: P3 Stage-1 x19 boundary and task/profile invariance
Any rewrite of historical P8/P9/P10 contracts, reports, thresholds, or verdicts
